description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walandura, Kuruwita D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620295
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 188, 189, and 43) with detailed ownership information, property boundaries, and legal encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land property rights, ownership transfers, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
